    DEMIC Chips

    Chips that DEM characters set to learn skills, since they have no jobs.

    On this page
    • Where to buy
    • How DEM grow
    • All chips

    Where to buy

    • Talk to the Lab Guide in Downtown and choose DEM Customize Room.

      Lab Guide

    • Or talk to Snub in West Fort City.

      Snub

    • In the DEM Customize Room, buy chips from Dr. Quark.

      Dr. Quark

    How DEM grow

    • A DEM's level alone doesn't raise its stats. Spend EP to raise the Cost Limit, which lets you set more chips.
    • Setting an Engage Task on the panel costs 1 EP. It doubles the chips next to it.
    • Chips work only in Machina Form. In Normal Form you wear normal equipment instead.
